description_en: Gets a predictive outbound campaign by its ID from a specified instance
description_zh: 调用GetCampaign获取指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动
name: GetCampaign

ActualEndTime.description_en: The actual end time of the predictive outbound campaign. This is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
ActualEndTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动实际结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

ActualStartTime.description_en: The actual start time of the predictive outbound campaign. This is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
ActualStartTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动实际开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

CampaignId.description_en: The ID of the predictive outbound campaign

CasesAborted.description_zh: 取消呼叫的联系人数量

CasesUncompleted.description_zh: 未完呼叫的联系人数量

CasesUncompletedAfterAttempted.description_en: The number of attempted but unconnected contacts that are still eligible for redial
CasesUncompletedAfterAttempted.description_zh: 尝试呼叫过但未接通，且未达到最大尝试次数的联系人数量。即经过重试后呼叫成功的联系人

CompletionRate.description_en: The ratio of connected contacts to the total number of contacts

ContactFlowId.description_en: The ID of the associated Contact Flow

MaxAttemptCount.description_en: The maximum number of call attempts for each contact. If an attempt fails, the contact is redialed until this limit is reached
MaxAttemptCount.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的最大尝试次数，表示当活动的号码呼叫失败时，最多重呼几次

MinAttemptInterval.description_en: The minimum interval, in seconds, to wait before redialing a failed call
MinAttemptInterval.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的最小重呼间隔，表示失败重呼时的最小间隔，单位秒

Name.description_en: The name of the predictive outbound campaign

PlanedEndTime.description_en: The planned end time of the predictive outbound campaign. This is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
PlanedEndTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动计划结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

PlanedStartTime.description_en: The planned start time of the predictive outbound campaign. This is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
PlanedStartTime.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动计划开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

QueueId.description_en: The ID of the associated skill group

QueueName.description_en: The name of the associated skill group

Simulation.description_en: Indicates whether the campaign is a test simulation. This parameter is not intended for production use
Simulation.description_zh: 是否为模拟活动，用于测试，普通客户无需关心

SimulationParameters.description_en: The parameters for a test simulation. This parameter is not intended for production use
SimulationParameters.description_zh: 模拟活动参数，用于测试，普通客户无需关心

State.description_en: The state of the predictive outbound campaign

StrategyParameters.description_en: The strategy parameters for the predictive outbound campaign, in JSON format. For a `PID` strategy, the format is `{"abandonRate":"5","historicalConnectedRate":"35"}`. For a `PACING` strategy, the format is `{"ratio":1}`. `abandonRate` specifies the target abandon rate, `historicalConnectedRate` specifies the historical connection rate for reference, and `ratio` specifies the fixed dialing ratio
StrategyParameters.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的策略参数，PID策略下的格式参数示例：{"abandonRate":"5","historicalConnectedRate":"35"}，PACING策略下的格式参数示例：{"ratio":1}。abandonRate表示期望呼损率，historicalConnectedRate表示历史参考接通率，ratio表示固定外呼比例

StrategyType.description_en: The dialing strategy for the predictive outbound campaign
StrategyType.description_zh: 预测式外呼活动的策略模式

enumValueTitles.PACING: 固定比例外呼，外呼数量 = 空闲坐席 * 比例
enumValueTitles.PID: 系统基于PID控制策略，自动调整外呼电话数量
